en.name: Glutinous rice
en.summary: Dry glutinous rice keeps like any other white rice: about 2 years from purchase in a sealed container, about 1 year once opened, and about 6 months refrigerated after opening. All three figures are read across unchanged from white rice, since no authority publishes a separate home shelf life for 糯米 — and there is no reason to expect it to differ.
en.pantry: Store it airtight, cool, dark and dry: 2 years from purchase, and about 1 year once the bag is open. Glutinous rice is higher in the amylopectin that makes it sticky and lower in amylose than ordinary rice, but for storage purposes it behaves exactly like white rice — the milling has taken the bran and germ away, which is what makes both of them keep. Rice weevils get in through paper sacks, so decant into a sealed container rather than folding the bag over. A musty smell means mould, and washing it and using it anyway is not the answer.
en.fridge: An airtight container in the fridge gives about 6 months after opening. That is the right choice in a humid Taiwanese summer, where both insects and the slow staling of the grain move faster than they do in a cool dry cupboard — cold deals with both. Seal it properly, because rice picks up fridge smells, and let the container come back to room temperature before opening so moisture condenses on the outside and not on the grain.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for dry glutinous rice and it does not need one — the cupboard and fridge figures already cover far more than a household gets through. A sealed bag in the freezer for a few days is a legitimate way to kill weevil eggs in a sack bought from a bulk bin, but that is a pest measure rather than a shelf life. Cooked glutinous rice is a different matter entirely and freezes very well.
spoilage: A musty or mouldy smell in the bag — do not rinse it and cook it anyway.
Live weevils, small moths, webbing or fine powdery dust.
Grains gone yellow or with dark spots.
Cooked rice that tastes stale and flat however it is seasoned.
tips: Decant into a sealed container the day you buy it; paper sacks are not insect-proof.
Buy round or long glutinous rice according to the dish, and label the jar — they are hard to tell apart.
Keep an opened jar in the fridge through a humid summer.
Date the container from purchase, not from the packing date.

faq.q: How long does dry glutinous rice keep?
faq.a: About 2 years from purchase sealed, about 1 year once opened, or about 6 months refrigerated after opening.

faq.q: Does glutinous rice keep differently from ordinary rice?
faq.a: No. It is stickier because of its starch make-up, but for storage it behaves like white rice, and the figures are read straight across.

faq.q: Should glutinous rice be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: It is worth it in a hot, humid summer, in an airtight container — it slows both insects and staling.

zh.name: 糯米
zh.summary: 乾的糯米保存方式和其他白米一樣：密封保存從購買日起算約 2 年，開封後約 1 年，開封後冷藏約 6 個月。這三個數字都是原封不動從白米讀過來的，因為沒有任何機關替糯米公布過單獨的家庭保存期限——也沒有理由認為它會不一樣。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、避光、乾燥保存：從購買日起算 2 年，開封後約 1 年。糯米的支鏈澱粉比例較高（所以黏）、直鏈澱粉較低，但在保存上它的表現和白米一模一樣——碾米已經把麩皮和胚芽去掉了，而那正是兩者都耐放的原因。米象會從紙袋鑽進去，所以請倒進密封容器，不要把袋口折一折就算了。聞到霉味就是發霉，「洗一洗照樣煮」不是解決辦法。
zh.fridge: 密封容器放冰箱，開封後約 6 個月。在台灣潮濕的夏天這是正確選擇：害蟲和米粒的緩慢老化在濕熱環境裡都跑得比較快，而低溫同時處理這兩件事。容器要確實密封，因為米很會吸冰箱的味道；開封前先讓它回到室溫，讓水氣凝在容器外面而不是米上。
zh.freezer: 乾糯米沒有給冷凍期限，也不需要——櫥櫃和冷藏的數字已經遠超過一般家庭的消耗速度。把密封袋放冷凍幾天，是散裝購買時殺死蟲卵的正當做法，但那是防蟲措施，不是保存期限。煮熟的糯米飯則完全是另一回事，而且非常適合冷凍。
spoilage: 袋裡聞到霉味——不要洗一洗就照煮。
看到活的米象、小蛾、絲網或細粉屑。
米粒泛黃或出現深色斑點。
煮出來的飯不管怎麼調味都陳味十足、風味平淡。
tips: 買回來當天就倒進密封容器；紙袋擋不住蟲。
依料理選圓糯或長糯，並在罐子上標示——它們不好分辨。
潮濕的夏天，開封後的那一罐請放冰箱。
容器上標「購買日期」，不是包裝上的製造日期。

faq.a: 密封保存從購買日起算約 2 年，開封後約 1 年，開封後冷藏約 6 個月。

faq.q: 糯米的保存方式和一般白米不同嗎？
faq.a: 沒有不同。它因為澱粉組成而比較黏，但在保存上就當白米看待，數字也是直接沿用。
在濕熱的夏天值得，請用密封容器——低溫同時延緩生蟲和老化。
